summary: The risk flagged last week landed, and it landed on the money. Liza paid the Aug 1-14 invoice early on Aug 19 ($5,000 + $2,433 = $7,433, three wires, three screenshots). Nobody at ALTR acknowledged it. Six days later she had to chase her own payment: 'Pls confirm if you guys received those too thank you' (Aug 25). Stephski replied 31 hours after that with 'Thank you! Checking these', then 'got the 5000! waiting for the others to show up'. Liza's answer is the tell: 'So out of all wires you only got 5k?' - the first flicker of friction on this account in thirteen months. She then disclosed the cause herself: 'Please check your account cause wires bounced back we did them from banking online they all bounce back and we had to resend them', and volunteered the sender names unprompted ('Some wires coming from Leticia Linss, others from José Muñoz'). Those wires bounced out of an account number Stephski changed inside the Aug 15 invoice message - the fifth banking change since Sep 2025 and the second in six weeks. That is not a client payment problem, it is an ALTR banking-ops problem that the client is now debugging on ALTR's behalf. Her last three messages (Aug 26, 19:44-20:18) have gone unanswered for 37 hours and are still unanswered as this report closes. Meanwhile: this is the THIRD consecutive week in which 100% of chat traffic was billing. Derrek has not sent a message since Aug 4 - 24 days of owner silence - and his Aug 1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k Phone Farm is now 20 days past its window on her self-declared #1 priority. Mica has skipped reel inspo two weeks running (last drop Aug 13, 15 days). Ronnie's OF tag-a-creator investigation is 19 days overdue. Vivek, introduced Jul 29 as the Meta Support Rep to '@ him in the chat', has never sent a single message in 30 days. And the DMCA takedown reports she used to thank Nick for by name stopped on 2026-03-04 - 177 days of zero reporting on a service she explicitly valued. The account is now: an invoice goes out, the money bounces, and she chases it.

health.rationale: Down 9 from 66. Last week's report predicted the exact failure: 'if a shortfall surfaces next week it will be the third consecutive wire cycle with a discrepancy'. It surfaced, and it is worse than a shortfall - the wires physically bounced out of ALTR's newly-changed account number, only $5,000 of a stated $7,433 is confirmed 13 days after the invoice, and the client discovered and diagnosed it herself after six days of silence. Three compounding downgrades: (1) money now visibly broken, not just unacknowledged; (2) the first negative-toned client message on record ('So out of all wires you only got 5k?') plus three unanswered messages sitting 37 hours old at window close; (3) a third straight billing-only week with Derrek at 24 days silent and his Phone Farm promise 20 days past window. The only reason this is not lower is that Liza's behaviour is still fully cooperative - she resent the bounced wires at her own cost and effort and volunteered the sender names without being asked. She is doing ALTR's job for it. That is goodwill being spent down, not goodwill in reserve.
